ticker_news.title: AMD Q3 Earnings Preview: AI Momentum Fuels Upbeat Setup
ticker_news.description: AMD is preparing to report Q3 earnings with strong AI momentum, highlighted by a major GPU deal with OpenAI and potential significant revenue expansion in data center and AI infrastructure markets.
ticker_news.author: Ali Merchant

ticker_news.title: AMD Q3 Earnings: Revenue, EPS Top Estimates As AI Data Center Business Drives Growth
ticker_news.description: AMD reported strong Q3 earnings with revenue of $9.25 billion, beating analyst estimates and representing a 36% year-over-year increase. The company's AI data center business and high-performance processors drove significant growth, with CEO Lisa Su highlighting record revenue and profitability.
ticker_news.author: Adam Eckert
